name: CASHBACK SBI Card

reward_terms.snapshot_note: CASHBACK SBI Card e-kit T&C, 47pp. Section 11 (Card Cashback) and Section 13 (fuel surcharge) are the ingested reward source.

version._note: Fee 999/999, renewal waived on annual spend >= 2,00,000 (see waiver threshold). Forex 3.5% (MITC standard, non-premium tier).

currencies._note: Direct statement-credit cashback. v = 1. No redemption ambiguity.

earning_rules._note: 5% on online spends. 'Online' identified by network online indicators (T&C 11.1.c). Floor rounding per txn (T&C 11.1.v: 2999 x 5% = 149, floored from 149.95).
1% on offline (non-online) spends. Any txn not flagged online is offline.

caps._note: Max 2,000 cashback on online per statement cycle. Overflow earns nothing (T&C 11: 'will not accrue any cashback till next cycle'). Statement-cycle approximated as calendar month (MVP; trace-flag cycle_approximated).
Max 2,000 cashback on offline per statement cycle.
Aggregate online+offline cashback capped 4,000 per statement cycle. Card-scoped so it binds across both earning rules.

exclusions._note: No cashback on: fuel, wallet, rent, jewelry, education, utility, insurance, card/gift/novelty, railways, member-FI/quasi-cash, digital gaming, tolls, government. MCC list per T&C 11.1.d table. These still count toward fee-waiver spend (not excluded from fee_waiver scope).

Cashback not applicable on transactions less than 100 (T&C 11.1.s). Modelled as exclusion of sub-100 txns from rewards. NOTE: category-mode approximation cannot see individual txns; flag as txn-mode-only precision.

_engine_compatibility_note: Both entries in exclusions[] above use selector fields (mcc_include, txn_max) that Part C defines but engine/card_bundle.py::_exclusion_selector_from_dict does not read, and engine/eligibility.py cannot evaluate (Stage 2 only supports categories/channels/merchant_group/geography). These are the CORRECT Part C field names -- this is an engine-support gap, not a naming error, so nothing here was renamed. IMPORTANT: loading exclusions[] as-is through bundle_from_dict is UNSAFE, not just inert -- _exclusion_selector_from_dict silently drops mcc_include/txn_max, producing an ExclusionSelector with every field None, which engine/eligibility.py's _selector_matches treats as MATCHES EVERYTHING. Since excluded_from=['rewards'], this would zero out ALL cashback, not just the intended fuel/rent/sub-Rs100 spend. Any tooling loading this bundle must drop or specially handle exclusions[] until MCC/txn-value selector support lands in the engine. See docs/DECISIONS.md #111; tests/test_golden_sbi_cashback.py's _adapt_ingestion_bundle demonstrates the safe handling.

thresholds._note: Renewal fee waived on annual spend >= 2,00,000. Waiver-eligible spend = all spend (rent/fuel excluded from REWARDS but NOT from waiver, unless MITC says otherwise — confirm rent inclusion in review).

surcharges._note: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on txns 500-3000, max 100/statement/account (FAQ 17 + T&C 13.1). engine/costs.py::Surcharge has no field for the 'waiver' sub-object above -- it is NOT consumed by bundle_from_dict (silently ignored, same as any other unread key), and the refund it describes is NOT modelled anywhere yet. Per docs/DECISIONS.md #26's syn_fuel precedent, this needs to become a SEPARATE capped earning_rule (refunding the surcharge) before this card's real fuel-surcharge economics are correctly represented. See docs/DECISIONS.md #110.

_review_checklist: Confirm 'online' vs 'offline' channel mapping matches how SBI flags transactions (network online indicator).
Confirm whether rent (MCC 6513/7349) counts toward the 2L fee-waiver even though excluded from rewards — MITC/T&C wording.
Confirm forex 3.5% for CASHBACK specifically in the MITC fee table (not a premium-tier exception).
Statement-cycle caps approximated as calendar-month for MVP — flagged, acceptable per A.17.
Sub-100 txn exclusion is txn-mode-only; category-mode value will slightly overstate — acceptable, flagged.
